title: Filter member notes at the shared group changelog boundary

setupFiles.monochange.toml:
[defaults]
parent_bump = "patch"
[package."@acme/api"]
path = "packages/api"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/ui"]
path = "packages/ui"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/tokens"]
path = "packages/tokens"
type = "npm"
[group.main]
packages = ["@acme/api", "@acme/ui", "@acme/tokens"]
version_format = "primary"
[ecosystems.npm]
enabled = true
[lints.rules]
"npm/workspace-protocol" = "off"

prompt: The main group releases api, ui, and tokens together, but the shared SDK changelog should describe only @acme/api. Configure its changelog at docs/sdk-changelog.md to include only api changes, then render the default main-group notes into sdk-notes.md for review. Keep both existing changesets and all manifest versions untouched.
expectation: A group changelog include list limits the shared changelog file to api while preserving group membership and both pending changesets. Default group notes describe the complete release, including ui; the file-only include policy must not hide changes from the provider release body.

checks.why: The final configuration and pending changesets must resolve.
The filter must be persisted at the release owner.
The selected group note must contain the API change.

checks.command: scratch=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$scratch"' EXIT; cp -R . "$scratch"; cd "$scratch"; monochange prepare --format json >/dev/null && node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),a=require("node:assert/strict"),s=fs.readFileSync("docs/sdk-changelog.md","utf8");a.ok(s.includes("retryBudget"));a.ok(!s.includes("spinner"));'
checks.why: Actual preparation in a scratch copy must honor the curated file filter without consuming the agent workdir's pending intent.
Provider release notes must describe the whole group release even when its changelog file is curated.
Rendering notes must not consume release intent.
Notes do not advance manifest versions.
Evaluation is limited to local planning and preparation; registry, tag, release, and push operations are outside the task.
